description: PLAY-11/12 (owner decision 2026-11-27, option A): every class has its Classic level-1 ability from level 1 and the other training abilities at Classic trainer levels; in the training kit (levels 1-14) melee classes deal most damage with auto-attack and casters with spells, casters melee with a weak staff hit instead of a wand. Solo enemy curve at level 1 retuned for the ability from level 1 (levels 2-14 measured unchanged).

edits.name: Training kits: Classic trainer order and levels
Per-class Classic trainer levels
Training damage shape on the hero
Hunter training: Raptor Strike instead of Concussive Shot
Casters in training melee with a staff
edits.new: function autoOf(cls, spec) { if (!spec && (cls === 'mage' || cls === 'priest' || cls === 'warlock')) return TRAINING_STAFF; /* PLAY-11: учебный набор (spec null) */

edits.name: Training skill multiplier
edits.old: let amt = src.atk * mult * dmgMult(st, src) * (0.9 + st.rnd() * 0.2);
edits.new:
if (src.trainSkill && !opt.auto && !opt.refl) mult *= src.trainSkill; /* PLAY-11/12: учебный набор */
    let amt = src.atk * mult * dmgMult(st, src) * (0.9 + st.rnd() * 0.2);

edits.name: Expose the training shape
edits.old: return Object.freeze({classes: Object.freeze(Object.keys(catalog)), specLevel: 15, slots: slots, active: active});
edits.new: return Object.freeze({classes: Object.freeze(Object.keys(catalog)), specLevel: 15, slots: slots, active: active, shape: TRAINING_SHAPE});
